title: Dispatch: 19.5.12 deterministic capability inventory (attempt 1)
description:
Implement eshyra-o9bd.19.5.12 per its DESIGN field (D1-D6, read it fully; it supersedes older notes). Accuracy of every statement is the whole point: for each tool, open its module under packages/core/src/orchestrator/ and the state functions it calls; write operation/requiredInputs/exclusions/residualDmInterpretation from what the code actually does and refuses. Tabulate first (a scratch script listing each registered tool's name, description, required input fields, and module), then write entries. Work domain by domain (dice/resolution, HP/conditions/effects, combat/turns, items/currency/attunement, spells/slots, rests/resources/usage, world/plot/clock, ambiguity/rulings, read-only). For the resolve-check v1->v2 correction read packages/core/src/orchestrator/toolResolveCheck.ts in full (sheet derivation for skill/ability, refusal of caller-declared duplicates, attack rolls still declared) and update every reference/binding/test to v2. Engine (non-tool) entries: at minimum character creation finalize (finalizeCharacter.ts: sheet derivation incl. proficiencyGrants), level-up engine (levelUpEngine.ts: binding-derived class rules, choice application, proficiency ledger), class resource capacities (state/classResources.ts), campaign rules binding resolution (find the module used by rests/level-up from PRs #639/#640), checkpoint/replay (find the checkpoint module); add others you find while tabulating, each with runtimeOwner and existing evidence test paths.
Run npm run verify:worktree before committing; it must pass. Report (bd notes): counts per category (from your module, not hand-copied into tests), the NON_CAPABILITY_TOOLS list with reasons, the D5 list of disposition rows that now have inventory entries, every model-facing text change, and any tool whose behavior surprised you (possible defect: report it, do not fix it).
notes:
COMPLETION (commit 31a26154 on branch eshyra-o9bd.19.5.12.4; not pushed). verify:worktree passed (344 files / 6399 tests passed, 2 files skipped; no timeouts).
COUNTS (computed from DETERMINISTIC_CAPABILITY_INVENTORY, not hand-copied in tests): 86 entries = 71 tool + 15 engine. By surface/category: tool/state-integrity 37, tool/bounded-procedure 34, engine/state-integrity 8, engine/bounded-procedure 7. Registry has 74 tools = 71 inventory + 3 NON_CAPABILITY_TOOLS.
NON_CAPABILITY_TOOLS: lookup_rules (read-only retrieval of rules records), world_query (read-only; DM-only fields are annotated, visibility is not enforced), memory_drilldown (read-only retrieval of omitted memory). list_nearby_items and list_recoverable_items ARE inventoried (state-integrity) because they enforce a location/visibility boundary.
MODEL-FACING TEXT CHANGE (only one, per D5): resolve-check-v1 -> resolve-check-v2 in RULE_DETERMINISTIC_CAPABILITY_CONTRACTS; operation, exclusions and residualDmInterpretation restated from toolResolveCheck.ts (sheet derivation when skill/ability given; refusal of caller proficiency and of modifiers whose source names the governing ability; no derivation for attack rolls, monsters/combatants, or sheetless actors; DM still selects situational modifiers, advantage, DC/AC). runtimeOwner now also skillBonuses.ts, evidence also resolveCheckSheetDerivation.test.ts. All 8 bindings, ruleDispositions.ts report scope, and the tests in deterministicCapabilityLedger/ruleDispositions moved to v2. No bindings added, no dispositions changed. Audit-report scope stays three contracts (magic-item still excluded from the report).
D6: finding row engine-capability-ownership -> accepted (finding-registry.json); findingRegistry.test.ts disclosed-dependency list now ['magic-item-effects'].
D4: summarizeMagicItemCapabilityBacklog(records) in the inventory module (records, recordsWithReadiness, clauses, enginePendingClauses, hookCarryingClauses, enginePendingHookCarryingClauses), disposition unselected-candidate-backlog; tested structurally against the real pack. It is separate from the existing buildMagicItemLegacyCapabilityBacklog (candidate list), which is untouched.
D5 LIST (dispositions rows whose operation now has an inventory entry, input to a later presentation decision): rule:long-rest (complete_long_rest), rule:short-rest (complete_short_rest, spend_rest_hit_die), rule:death-saving-throws (record_death_save), rule:falling-unconscious + rule:instant-death (adjust_hp), rule:stabilizing-a-creature (stabilize_character), rule:healing + rule:temporary-hit-points (adjust_hp, grant_temporary_hp), rule:spell-slots (spend_spell_slot, flexible_casting), rule:attunement (attune_item, end_attunement), rule:gaining-inspiration + rule:using-inspiration (award_inspiration, use_inspiration), rule:bonus-action + rule:bonus-actions + rule:reactions + rule:your-turn + rule:other-activity-on-your-turn + rule:legendary-actions (begin_turn, spend_turn_resource), rule:surprise (set_surprised, roll/resolve_retained_check), rule:limited-usage (spend_usage, restore_usage, reset_usage), rule:contests (resolve_contest), rule:damage-rolls + rule:critical-hits + rule:damage-resistance-and-vulnerability (resolve_damage), rule:passive-checks + rule:group-checks (calc), rule:feats + rule:beyond-1st-level (level-up-v1 engine entry), rule:customizing-a-background + rule:backgrounds-proficiencies + rule:backgrounds-equipment (finalize-character-v1 engine entry). rule:abilities, rule:ability-scores-and-modifiers, rule:constitution-hit-points, rule:grapple-rules-for-monsters, rule:gaining/other rows have no dedicated entry.
Engine entries (15, each with runtimeOwner + existing evidence tests): finalize-character-v1, creation-class-choices-v1, creation-spell-counts-v1, proficiency-grants-v1, level-up-v1, class-resource-capacity-v1, campaign-rules-binding-resolution-v1, checkpoint-store-v1, turn-replay-v1, schema-migration-runner-v1, mutate-state-v1, bounded-procedure-executor-v1 (retained, STAGED: only create/convert-spell-slot have a consumer, flexibleCasting.ts; hazard-save, weapon-damage and feature-option request kinds have none; successor owner = eshyra-4xx6, filed), item-reset-executor-v1, progression-event-ledger-v1, derived-magic-item-clauses-v1 (ledger quote).
SUSPECTED TOOL DEFECTS / SURPRISES (reported, not fixed): (1) record_death_save and restore_usage take a caller-supplied natural die result (range-checked only); nothing verifies it came from the roll tool, so RNG integrity there depends on model honesty (docs/headers say 'roll first'). (2) memory_drilldown takes campaignId from model args and passes it straight to memoryDrilldown without comparing to ctx.campaignId (not exploitable if one campaign per DB; no authorization check). (3) roll's description omits category 'hit_die' that the schema enum accepts. (4) roll_retained_check/resolve_retained_check/resolve_contest never derive modifiers from the sheet (declared only), unlike resolve_check v2 - consistent but asymmetric. (5) add_condition preserves duration/severity fields without interpreting them.
